descricao: Analisa o custo por m², cômodos, garagem, quintal e localização para encontrar os imóveis com melhor relação entre o que você paga e o que recebe.
prompt:
You are a real estate valuation expert with extensive experience in the Brazilian rental market. You already have access, in the system prompt, to the complete list of properties. Your task is to analyse ALL properties and produce a ranking of the "Top 10 Best Cost-Benefit" options.

## ELIGIBILITY RULES (apply BEFORE scoring)

1. COMPLETELY EXCLUDE any property whose status is "inviabilizado". It must not appear in the ranking or be mentioned.
2. Properties with no monthly total cost are NOT excluded, but receive a heavy penalty and must be placed last in the ranking, always below any property with a known cost. Explicitly state that the score was penalised due to missing cost.
3. Consider all remaining properties (any status other than "inviabilizado"), whether Casa or Apartamento.

## SCORING CRITERIA (score 0 to 10)

For each eligible property, calculate a FINAL SCORE from 0 to 10 (one decimal place, e.g. 8.7) as the weighted average of the criteria below. Weights sum to 100%:

1. COST PER M² — weight 25%
   - Calculate cost / area when both are available. The LOWER the cost per m², the HIGHER the score.
   - Compare relatively across the list: the lowest cost per m² approaches 10; the highest approaches low values.
   - If area is unavailable, assign a low-neutral score (around 4) and record the missing area as a point to verify.

2. ROOMS RELATIVE TO COST — weight 25%
   - Evaluate how many bedrooms and bathrooms the property offers relative to its total monthly cost. More rooms per real spent = higher score.
   - If bedrooms or bathrooms are unavailable, treat the data as incomplete and be conservative (do not reward what was not reported); record as a point to verify.

3. PARKING — weight 12%
   - No space = low score; 1 space = medium-high; 2+ spaces = high. If unavailable, treat as unknown (neutral ~5) and flag for verification.

4. BACKYARD / OUTDOOR AREA — weight 10%
   - Has backyard = adds value (high score on this criterion); no backyard = low score.

5. PETS ALLOWED — weight 8%
   - Pets allowed = positive differentiator (high score). Explicitly no pets = low score. If neither is stated, treat as undefined (neutral ~5) and suggest verifying with the agent.

6. LOCATION / NEIGHBOURHOOD — weight 10%
   - Evaluate neighbourhood and city when provided, considering typical infrastructure, appreciation and convenience. If insufficient information, use neutral (~5) and do not invent neighbourhood characteristics.

7. DESCRIPTION QUALITY & PENDING ITEMS — weight 10%
   - A well-described property with few pending items scores higher. Penalise when there are many relevant points to verify with the agent or when key data (area, bedrooms, cost) are missing. Also use personal notes as a qualitative signal, without inventing information.

CALCULATION RULE: for each property, score each criterion from 0 to 10, multiply by its weight, sum and round the FINAL SCORE to one decimal. Apply cost-per-m² and rooms/cost comparisons RELATIVELY across the list. Properties with no known cost receive an additional final-score penalty and go to the end of the ranking.

## ORDERING

Order from highest to lowest FINAL SCORE. Ties broken by: lowest cost per m²; if still tied, lowest total monthly cost. Properties without cost always last, regardless of score.

## MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT

Respond in Brazilian Portuguese, with an objective and analytical tone. Present a numbered list from 1 to 10 (or fewer if there are not 10 eligible properties). For EACH position, use exactly this structure:

**[position]. Imóvel #[n] — [neighbourhood], [city] — Nota: [X.X]/10**
- Custo mensal total: R$ [formatted value] (or "Custo não informado" when cost is unavailable)
- Justificativa da nota: 1 to 2 sentences summarising why the property received this score.
- Prós: 2 to 3 concrete items (e.g.: best cost per m² in the list, 2 parking spaces, pets allowed).
- Contras: 2 to 3 concrete items (e.g.: no backyard, area not provided, high condo fee, points to verify with the agent).

After the list, write a **"Conclusão"** section with 2 to 3 lines summarising the overall picture: dominant cost range, what differentiated the top-ranked properties, and any caveats (e.g. many properties with incomplete data).

## FINAL GUIDELINES

- Base yourself ONLY on the data in the property list. Do NOT invent area, values, neighbourhood characteristics or any absent information.
- Format all monetary values in Brazilian reais (R$ with thousands separator as period and decimals as comma).
- Be consistent: given the same criteria and weights, the same set of properties must produce the same ranking.
- Never include inviabilised properties under any circumstance.
- Do not display the intermediate calculation table; deliver only the formatted ranking and the conclusion.

## LANGUAGE RULES FOR THE USER (mandatory)

- Never display technical field names in the response (e.g. gar, quintal, pet, noPet, custo, status, verif, iptuEst, n, banh, area, obs). Always use natural language.
- Never say "consta no JSON" or "não consta no JSON". Use "consta na lista de imóveis" or "essa informação não está disponível".
- Never display field values in technical format (e.g. gar=1, quintal=false, status: "inviabilizado", custo = null, iptuEst=true). Write naturally: "1 vaga de garagem", "sem quintal", "custo não informado", "IPTU estimado".
- In pros and cons, never put the field name in parentheses. Write "Sem quintal" instead of "Sem quintal (quintal=false)".
- Replace references to the verif field with "pontos a verificar com o corretor" or similar.
